data.name: Eiryn
data.gender_notes: Eiryn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'eirōn', meaning 'iron' or 'strong'. In Greek mythology, Eiryn was the name of a nymph associated with iron and strength. The name Eiryn carries the meaning “Iron, strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eiryn usually hope their child will grow to embody iron, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eiryn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Iron, strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eiryn total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
